verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-015 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-015: administrative recovery override is an exceptional flow with enhanced audit
verdicts.why: The check refuses an operator-initiated override, permits the administrator flow, prevents credential exposure, and requires exactly one dedicated recovery-override audit through _one_audit.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-005 [witness: verification:end_to_end_walkthrough_client_portal]; INV-005, INV-006 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal]; INV-006 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal]; INV-006 [witness: verification:service_identity_consumer_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-005: a revoked grant, credential, viewer, or session blocks the next authorization check immediately, per the revocation cascade table
INV-006: a suspended or disabled staff account and a disabled service principal have no valid sessions or usable credentials
verdicts.why: It detects use of a revoked staff session and refuses authentication/session resolution for a suspended staff account. It does not cover the full revocation cascade, usable credentials for a disabled account, or disabled service principals.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-051 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal]; INV-053 [witness: verification:snapshot_import_sqlite_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-051: every action in the audit catalog writes exactly one AuditRecord with actor provenance; service actors record key_version
INV-053: a rejected audit record of a significant mutation carries result=rejected and a closed reason_code
quotes: assert len(rows) == 1, f"{label}: expected exactly one {action.value} audit, saw {len(rows)}"
verdicts.why: It requires exactly one audit for numerous exercised actions and one audit per rejected sign-in. It does not assert actor provenance, service key_version, complete audit-catalog coverage, or result=rejected with a closed reason_code for rejected significant mutations.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-018 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal]; INV-019 [witness: verification:credential_security_policy_client_portal].
statements: INV-018: staff login email uniqueness and lookup use the R16 syntax-valid (whitespace refused) Unicode-casefolded form without provider-specific rewriting
INV-019: new staff passwords satisfy R16 length/control-character policy and are hashed exactly as supplied without trimming or normalization
quotes: "change_staff_password with a new password below the minimum length",
verdicts.why: It checks casefolded email storage, case-insensitive duplicate rejection, and one below-minimum password rejection. It does not test whitespace refusal, general email syntax, control-character rejection, or hashing an input that distinguishes exact supply from trimming or normalization.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-003 [witness: verification:credential_security_policy_client_portal]; INV-003 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-003: passwords, session tokens, viewer access tokens and service credentials are stored only in verification/hash form and never logged
verdicts.why: It verifies that staff passwords are not persisted as plaintext and that password hashes do not escape in returned views. It does not inspect storage of session tokens, viewer tokens, or service credentials, and does not assert that any of these secrets are never logged.

verdicts.item:
- TXN-001: the staff identity unit-of-work check
  [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal].
statements:
TXN-001: no transaction is rolled back twice, rolled back after a commit,
  or left open.
quotes: assert self.open_count == 0, f"{label}: left {self.open_count} transaction(s) open"
verdicts.why: Every instrumented operation is settled, requiring no open transaction and exactly one close event per transaction; double rollback, rollback after commit, and other double closes are detected.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: entity_id canonical [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal]; entity_id canonical [witness: verification:staff_bootstrap_client_portal].
statements:
Every audit record's `entity_id` equals the canonical string of the audited
  entity's id, or is absent when that entity has none.
verdicts.why: For audits passed an entity_id through _one_audit, it compares the stored value with str(entity_id), the UUID's canonical string. It does not inspect every audit record or require entity_id absence for entities without an ID.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-014 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-014: a staff account authenticates only in active status; pending_verification cannot log in
verdicts.why: It proves that pending_verification and suspended accounts cannot authenticate and that an activated account can. It does not attempt authentication while disabled, so an implementation allowing disabled-account login could escape detection.

verdicts.item: - Witnesses, the focused Factory verification checks that assert it: INV-001, INV-017, PLAT-REG-003 [witness: verification:authorization_guard_client_portal]; INV-004 [witness: verification:staff_identity_uow_client_portal].
statements: INV-001: every project-scoped operation passes the guard sequence: valid session, active principal, project access, required capability, Registry lifecycle policy; first failure wins
INV-004: authentication flows never reveal account or viewer existence; auth failures never expose project data

INV-017: an operator may access a project only through one active StaffProjectAssignment; revocation blocks the next project-scoped authorization check immediately; current administrators derive project scope from the single administrative area policy
PLAT-REG-003: a linked mutation succeeds only after server-side typed validation reports the same UUID as active
quotes: "assign_staff_project for a project the Registry does not know",
verdicts.why: It weakly covers concealed authentication rejection and Registry rejection of unknown or archived projects. It does not assert the complete ordered guard sequence and first-failure behavior, immediate assignment-revocation authorization effects, single-assignment/administrative-area scope rules, or validation returning the same UUID.
